paragraphs: R' Shimon, brother of R' Berekhiah.
He is mentioned in Berakhot, chapter 6, end of halakhah 1, but Hyman says the reading there should be R' Shmuel, as cited in Orlah, beginning of chapter 2.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״ו סה״א is read as Berakhot chapter 6 end-of-halakhah 1; רפ״ב gives Orlah beginning-of-chapter 2. No Talmud corpus or edition is independently established. Earlier machine פ״1 differs from supplied פ״ו; the exact source labels remain here.
Shmuel in place of Shimon is Hyman’s proposed correction, not newly attested or silently adopted in the heading. The brother relation remains, with all three personal titles R'.
